notes: This contract pins the portable C++ TCK's timestamped Send Interaction entry point to the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ API. Companion API-reference contracts pin timestamped receive callbacks, time regulation/constrained services, and resignation. The source uses only standard RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; adapter inputs provide the provider, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. The scenario checks timestamp ordering across producers without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual MessageRetractionHandle sendInteraction( InteractionClassHandle const & interactionClass, ParameterHandleValueMap const & parameterValues, VariableLengthData const & userSuppliedTag, LogicalTime const & time) = 0
